body:
Rose Quartz is the most recognized stone for love—offering emotional healing, compassion, and deep heart support. It encourages self-acceptance while opening the heart to give and receive love more freely.

This bracelet is centered with a solid copper activation bead, enhancing Rose Quartz’s ability to circulate loving energy throughout the emotional and energetic body. Copper strengthens resonance and flow, making this bracelet especially supportive for emotional healing.

Rose Quartz helps dissolve emotional wounds, self-criticism, and fear-based patterns. It nurtures hope and trust, allowing the heart to remain open even after disappointment.

This bracelet is ideal for self-love practices, relationship healing, or emotional renewal. It supports love that feels safe, grounded, and enduring.
